claims.title: Native-velocity control: full finite-computable all-initial deterministic stabilizer

quoted_fields.interface: On unit T3, u_t+P[(u.grad)u]=nu*Delta u+P[(b.grad)u], div u=0 and mean u=0. The single prescribed b depends only on rational nu,K, has one rational spatial cosine mode, a degree-six rational time bump with rational breakpoints, is globally C2 and zero outside its finite pulse. It uses neither profile-dependent feedback, extra viscosity/damping, stochastic path selection, exceptional initial sets nor a PDE oracle. Both velocity polarisations and the infinite H3-ball tail are included.
quoted_fields.failure: Flandoli-Hofmanova-Luo-Nilssen2004.07528v3 revised v1 to a prescribed-measure epsilon-exceptional-set VORTICITY theorem. Agresti2607.15140v4 is native velocity but per-initial high probability/sup of probabilities, not a common deterministic driver. Curl/Leray transport and initial-condition quantifiers cannot silently transfer. L2 stability does not imply global strong continuation or a common small-data-basin certificate. These are root-reported checked source contracts, not new Capital primary reads or a full129-page verification.
